title: Coppernic
description: Datapack for consistency of Metallic materials within miscellaneous recipes or textures!
body:
# Choco's Coppernic!

Ever wondered how Stonecutters magically quadruple Cut Copper output? Or wanted to craft Chainmail Armour for decoration, only to find it lacks a recipe! Well, wonder no more!

This datapack improves miscellaneous Metallic recipes by correcting yield for consistency, creating precise output, introducing convenient new recipes/interactions and revamping outdated textures for Metallic items!

### Credits
- Thank you [IcarusIsBestGirl](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/icarusisbestgirl/) for creating [Consistent Chainmail](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/consistent-chains-java-edition/)! Go visit her Content Gallery, she produces really awesome art!
- Thank you [enr1c0wastaken](https://www.reddit.com/user/enr1c0wastaken/) for helping me create Chainlink sprite! Visit Enr1co's [Content Gallery](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/enr1c0/) for cool remodels!
- Thank you [Amaro_Lunático](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/amaro_lunatico/) for creating Copper Crafter textures! Visit Amaro's [Projects Page](https://modrinth.com/user/Amaro_Lunatico) for awesome quality-of-life resourcepacks!

### Other Resources
Visit [Chocos/mygazthehealer](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/mygazthehealer/) in PlanetMinecraft for reporting issues or discussions/recommendation/suggestions for the pack.

### NOTE
Feel free to tailor this datapack for your personal preference, as long as you credit me and respective collaborators accordingly! However, you may not redistribute any of the assets, either commercially or otherwise, without obtaining prior permission first.
